title: The Bright Shore Tower Block
victim: Oleg Shubin, chair of the residents' committee
teaser: The residents of the twenty-storey Bright Shore block gathered in the courtyard for a general meeting. Committee chair Shubin had promised to name, in front of everyone, the person who'd been stealing the building's money for three years, and went up for the minutes. The lift got stuck between the ninth and tenth floors, and when the doors were forced open, Shubin was dead. The minutes with that very name had vanished.
professions: Neighbour who's been renovating for three years
Mum on maternity leave from the sixth floor
Taxi driver from the fifteenth floor

habits.label: House slippers
habits.habit: Pads around the building in house slippers
clues: Among the street dirt on the lift floor there are soft tread-less prints, like from house slippers. The culprit wears house slippers.
A pompom torn off a slipper lies in the ninth-floor stairwell. The culprit wears house slippers.

habits.label: Dog hair
clues: Shubin's jacket has ginger dog hair on it, and he doesn't have a dog. The culprit's clothes are covered in dog hair.
The visitors' chair in the management company office has tufts of pale dog hair on it. The culprit's clothes are covered in dog hair.

habits.label: Cement dust
habits.habit: Clothes covered in grey cement dust
clues: The lift buttons have grey fingerprints in cement dust. The culprit's clothes are covered in cement dust.
Someone else's pram in the pram room has grey handprints from cement-covered palms. The culprit's clothes are covered in cement dust.

habits.label: Curlers
clues: A pink plastic curler that fell out of someone's hair lies in the corner of the lift. The culprit has curlers in their hair.
A curler pin lies in the ninth-floor stairwell, and the neighbours on that floor swear they don't use curlers. The culprit has curlers in their hair.

habits.label: Towelling robe
habits.habit: Walks around in a towelling bathrobe
clues: A long blue thread from a towelling robe is caught in the lift doors. The culprit walks around in a bathrobe.
A towelling bathrobe belt hangs by the attic door on the roof. The culprit walks around in a bathrobe.

habits.label: Smells of heart drops
clues: Through the dusty smell in the lift comes a sharp whiff of Corvalol heart drops, though Shubin didn't take them. The culprit smells of heart drops.
An empty bottle of Corvalol lies on a bench in the playground. The culprit smells of heart drops.

habits.label: White paint
habits.habit: Hands covered in fresh white paint
clues: The handrail in the lift has smears of fresh white paint. The culprit has white paint on their hands.
The management company office door has a handprint in white paint. The culprit has white paint on their hands.

habits.label: Slim cigarettes
clues: A slim cigarette end with lipstick on the filter lies in the ninth-floor stairwell. The culprit smokes slim cigarettes.
Under the parapet on the roof there are several very fresh slim cigarette ends. The culprit smokes slim cigarettes.

habits.label: Glasses on the forehead
habits.habit: Always has their glasses pushed up on their forehead
clues: A clear nose pad from a pair of glasses lies on the lift floor. The culprit wears their glasses on their forehead.
At 21:12 the camera at the entrance caught someone coming in and lowering their glasses from forehead to nose. The culprit wears their glasses on their forehead.

habits.label: Striped tracksuit
habits.habit: Wears a tracksuit with side stripes
clues: Through the gap in the lift doors the mum from the sixth floor saw white stripes down a trouser leg. The culprit wears a striped tracksuit.
A white thread from a tracksuit stripe is caught on a concrete pillar in the underground car park. The culprit wears a striped tracksuit.

habits.label: Cat food
habits.habit: Pockets stuffed with food for the stray cats
clues: Dry cat food is scattered on the lift floor. The culprit's pockets are full of cat food.
There's a heap of fresh cat food by a vent in the underground car park, and cats have gathered round it. The culprit's pockets are full of cat food.

habits.label: Walking poles
habits.habit: Goes everywhere with Nordic walking poles
clues: The lift wall has two round dents from the tips of walking poles. The culprit walks with Nordic walking poles.
A line of pole marks runs through the sand of the playground to the entrance. The culprit walks with Nordic walking poles.

habits.label: Smells of fried fish
clues: When the lift was opened, it smelled of fried fish. The culprit smells of fried fish.
A chair in the management company office still smells of fried fish. The culprit smells of fried fish.

habits.label: Green-stained fingers
clues: The lift's emergency call button has a green fingerprint on it. The culprit's fingers are stained with green antiseptic.
The pram room door has a green streak, like from fingers stained with green antiseptic. The culprit's fingers are stained with green antiseptic.

habits.label: Walking-stick umbrella
habits.habit: Carries a long umbrella in any weather
clues: The lift doors on the ninth floor were prised apart with something long with a curved handle: there are marks on the rubber seal. The culprit carries a long umbrella.
A metal umbrella tip lies in the ninth-floor stairwell. The culprit carries a long umbrella.

habits.label: Torch key ring
habits.habit: A little torch on their key ring
clues: When the lift light went out, residents below saw a narrow torch beam through the gap. The culprit has a torch on their key ring.
A tiny button battery, like from a key-ring torch, lies on the floor of the underground car park. The culprit has a torch on their key ring.

keys: The door to the lift machine room on the roof was opened with a key and locked again. The culprit had keys.
The management company office is locked, yet the minutes are gone from the desk drawer with no sign of a break-in. The culprit had keys.
sched: Every evening at nine Shubin took the lift down from his fifteenth floor, and the whole building knew it. The culprit knows the schedule.
At 21:05 the concierge goes off for a fifteen-minute tea break, and in that time you can get into the building unseen. The culprit knows the schedule.
tech: The lift wasn't stopped by a fault but by a command from the control panel in the machine room. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The lift camera recorded only a grey screen: it was switched off through the router in the utility cupboard. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
tools: The lock on the utility cupboard in the ninth-floor corridor was opened with a screwdriver, and the screws were put back afterwards. The culprit is handy with tools.
The lift doors were prised open with a crowbar very carefully, without leaving a single dent. The culprit is handy with tools.
passages: A service hatch leads from the roof into the lift shaft. Only the technicians know about it, and the hatch is open. The culprit knows the service passages.
A goods lift few people know about runs up from the underground car park, and right now it's standing on the ninth floor. The culprit knows the service passages.
strong: Shubin, who weighed nearly a hundred and twenty kilos, was propped in the corner of the lift. The culprit is physically strong.
The heavy slab covering the roof hatch was moved aside, and it normally takes two people to lift. The culprit is physically strong.
safe: The safe in the management company office was opened with the code, and the money collected for repairs was taken. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The combination key box in the pram room is open, and the roof key isn't in it. The culprit knows the safe combination.
cash: At 21:20 a transfer left the building's account to a contractor nobody had hired. The culprit had access to money.
Exactly half is missing from the concierge's envelope of money for the car park barrier. The culprit had access to money.
medic: Shubin had a bad heart, and his thermos of tea held a double dose of his own pills. The culprit knows about poisons.
There's an injection mark on Shubin's neck: he was given the sedative used to put large dogs to sleep. The culprit knows about poisons.
quiet: The door to the ninth-floor stairwell bangs through the whole building, yet nobody heard a thing. The culprit moves silently.
The ninth-floor neighbour's dog barks at any step on the landing, but that evening it stayed quiet. The culprit moves silently.
driver: Shubin's car in the underground car park has been moved to someone else's space, and its bonnet is still warm. The culprit can drive.
At 21:16 the courier's electric car pulled away from the entrance, though the courier insists he was at the meeting. The culprit can drive.
french: The meeting minutes were later found on the roof, and someone had added at the bottom "Adieu, président", French for "Farewell, chairman". The culprit knows French.
Right after Shubin's death a message came into the residents' chat from an unnamed number: "Il savait tout", French for "He knew everything". The culprit knows French.
